senses.gloss:
m. (-दृक्)
Blind.
E.
अ priv. and दृश the eye.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
1 Invisible, not to be seen.
2 Improper to be beheld.
E.
अ neg. दृश्य to be seen.

n. (-ष्टं)
1 Casual and unseen danger, (as from conflagration, inundation, &c.)
2 Fortune, destiny, fate.
3 (In logic) Virtue or vice, as the eventual cause of pleasure or pain.
mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Unseen, unforeseen.
2 Unknown, unfelt, not experienced.
E.
अ neg. and दृष्ट seen.

m. (-षः)
A form of treaty, in which the parties treat direct, without any mediator or surety, also अदृष्टनर and similar compounds.
E.
अदृष्ट unseen, and पुरुष, &c. man.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Unseen previously, unseen till now.
E.
अदृष्ट, and पूर्व्व before.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत)
1 Enjoying or undergoing good or bad fortune, more usually the former, fortunate.
E.
अदृष्ट, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A look of displeasure, evil eye.
E.
अ bad, and दृष्टि look.

f. (-का)
An angry or displeased look, evil-eye.
E.
अदृष्टि, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Respectful.
2 Respected, honoured, worshipped.
3 Zealous, diligent.
E.
आङ् before दृञ्^1 to have, and क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Venerable, respectable.
E.
आङ् before दृ to have, क्यप् affix; तुक् augment.
